_what: Judging the addresses a name resolves to, at the moment of connecting (do-work/resolved-address.mjs). A name that looks public can resolve to this computer or a private network (a rebinding answer), so the numbers it resolves to are judged by the same blocked ranges as an address written out (do-work/public-address.json), plus any `deny` ranges a caller adds. `refusal` is what every refused name answers: the same text as a name that does not exist, so a refusal does not tell a caller which private names or ranges there are.
